screen_records.name: Welcome to Alarka
screen_records.action: Entry only after guardian pairing intent. No sensor access before permission.

screen_records.name: Checking this device
screen_records.action: Read-only PackageManager/CameraManager/SensorManager probes; no false operational claim.

screen_records.name: Compatibility result
screen_records.action: Hardware availability separate from permission state and feature release status.

screen_records.name: Feature details
screen_records.action: Every feature must carry support, permission, availability, release status and observed_at.

screen_records.name: Secure device pairing
screen_records.action: Prohibit unsigned capability ingestion; bind to child and authenticated device.

screen_records.name: Before permissions
screen_records.action: Show purpose, required/optional, retention and who receives data before OS dialog.

screen_records.name: Location while using
screen_records.action: For Android 11+ never request foreground and background location in one request.

screen_records.name: Background location
screen_records.action: Android 11+ background location guided through settings; do not claim active until policy approved.

screen_records.name: Monitoring notifications
screen_records.action: Do not hide icon/system indicators; notification permission denial impacts transparency.

screen_records.name: Usage access
screen_records.action: Use UsageStatsManager permission state via AppOps; Android Settings, OS confirmation.

screen_records.name: Choose media access
screen_records.action: READ_MEDIA_* with selected-photo access; never infer all library files from partial grant.

screen_records.name: Microphone permission
screen_records.action: Do not solicit dangerous permission in commercial build unless released; use demo only.

screen_records.name: Camera access · Research
screen_records.action: Never auto-enable media merely because hardware exists. Demo shown as research-only.

screen_records.name: Managed-device mode
screen_records.action: Real device-owner enrollment may require factory reset; never claim admin equals owner.

screen_records.name: Screen-sharing consent
screen_records.action: Android 14+ per-session MediaProjection token; do not store consent for reuse.

screen_records.name: Android decision received
screen_records.action: ActivityResult then PackageManager/AppOps; never trust button-click or app-owned approval.

screen_records.name: Permission declined
screen_records.action: Handle don't-ask-again/Settings flow without harassment or bypass.

screen_records.name: Selected photos only
screen_records.action: Persist only allowed URI grants; never equate selected media with full library.

screen_records.name: Permission confirmed
screen_records.action: Local OS grant, server durable ACK and parent confirmation are distinct events.

screen_records.name: Setup complete
screen_records.action: Only permitted background components continue; main Alarka Activity need not remain open.

screen_records.name: Access changed in Settings
screen_records.action: Revocation can terminate app process: cannot guarantee immediate callback or push.

screen_records.name: Re-enable a permission
screen_records.action: A regrant updates permission state only; runtime operational and release gates separate.

screen_records.name: Offline changes queued
screen_records.action: No claims of instant revocation propagation; deadlines and monotonic versions.

screen_records.name: Your monitoring controls
screen_records.action: Visible identity and accessible privacy controls even after setup Activity normally closes.

screen_records.name: Child device connecting
screen_records.action: First parent frame before trusted pairing/attestation. No parental spoofed capability.

screen_records.name: Device overview
screen_records.action: Multiple counts should be derived separately, without conflating support/grant/active.

screen_records.name: Feature compatibility
screen_records.action: Never use a single green feature flag for OS grants and runtime eligibility.

screen_records.name: Setup progress
screen_records.action: Server stores versioned state, emits parent update on durable write.

screen_records.name: Access granted
screen_records.action: Do not call all dependent features fully operational based on an OS grant.

screen_records.name: Permission disabled
screen_records.action: Only a device-authenticated report justifies exact revocation claim; stop stream.

screen_records.name: Denied or unsupported?
screen_records.action: Do not suggest bypass for legal feature-off or absent hardware.

screen_records.name: Temporary access
screen_records.action: One-time camera/mic/location grants can terminate; TTL and capture-time check required.

screen_records.name: Partial media access
screen_records.action: No arbitrary filesystem access or inference of selected photo selection list.

screen_records.name: Remote camera conditions
screen_records.action: Permission green but media operational amber / release flag OFF.

screen_records.name: Screen request approval
screen_records.action: No repeated media projection token reuse; do not promise remote activation.

screen_records.name: Managed-mode requirement
screen_records.action: Device Admin access alone does not create device-owner authority.

screen_records.name: Alarka is offline
screen_records.action: No fabricated 'permission revoked' result from stale/offline snapshot.

screen_records.name: Status needs recheck
screen_records.action: Per-feature TTL; stale not green; recheck at command execution.

screen_records.name: Status restored
screen_records.action: Server broadcasts only after durable write and monotonic version validation.

screen_records.name: Permission change history
screen_records.action: Change audit reason/actor/source with limited retention; no raw media or protected data.

screen_records.name: How to enable location
screen_records.action: No parent-side silent permission grant; preserve Android user agency.

screen_records.name: Guardian access check
screen_records.action: Authorization for report reading and permission-related commands must be child-specific.

screen_records.name: Report version conflict
screen_records.action: Monotonic version + compare-and-set; reject duplicates/conflicts and require device-signed source.

screen_records.name: Privacy switch disabled
screen_records.action: Do not override global sensor controls; report exact reason only with actual device evidence.

screen_records.name: Approval reversed
screen_records.action: Revocation may kill process; event can only appear after subsequent authenticated sync.

screen_records.name: Full compatibility details
screen_records.action: Green operational only if supported + proper access + context + release approved + fresh confirmation.

screen_records.name: Media activity
screen_records.action: Parent shows only authorized children; default last 7 days; server cursor pagination, no server media file links.

screen_records.name: Choose a child
screen_records.action: Accessible dropdown filters using child name + masked ID; no child from another family. Parent changes clear cursor.

screen_records.name: Date range
screen_records.action: Timezone localized, to-exclusive UTC server boundary; reject reversed/oversized/retention-exceeding queries.

screen_records.name: Filter results
screen_records.action: Filters are server-side and intersect date and child scopes; page cursor resets upon any filter change.

screen_records.name: Session details
screen_records.action: VIEWED_ONLY only if parent display/playback receipt verified. Live-only file_size_bytes is NULL.

screen_records.name: Saved recording details
screen_records.action: Historical receipt cannot prove parent file remains after deletion; do not provide server download links.

screen_records.name: Why did it fail?
screen_records.action: Show exact OS error only when verified. Phone call/mic-used attribution cannot be invented.

screen_records.name: No matching activity
screen_records.action: Empty is distinct from unauthorized, failed server request, and offline device.

screen_records.name: Historical activity offline
screen_records.action: Read-only history does not wake child. Never infer a sensor-specific failure from an offline phone.

screen_records.name: Browse more activity
screen_records.action: Stable sort (request_at DESC, ID DESC) and signed cursors with previous/next; no duplicate rows on changes.

screen_records.name: Access not available
screen_records.action: No cross-family ID enumeration and expired guardian grants invalidate cached pages.

screen_records.name: Administrator sign-in
screen_records.action: Separate admin JWT audience, MFA, short TTL, server-side role and case. No media log data before sign-in.

screen_records.name: Operations overview
screen_records.action: No named children in routine support dashboard. Hide aggregate when small-number inference risky.

screen_records.name: Request case-based access
screen_records.action: Case/purpose scope server-issued, expiring; ordinary operator role cannot grant itself universal search.

screen_records.name: Media activity explorer
screen_records.action: Parent/child names resolved read-time under active scope; filter intersection + max page size and stable cursor pagination.

screen_records.name: Search parent accounts
screen_records.action: Name/ID autocomplete debounced and server-scope filtered; lookup itself recorded in access audit.

screen_records.name: Search children
screen_records.action: Child parent relationship validated server-side; dropdown may not reveal siblings outside explicit case.

screen_records.name: Media record details
screen_records.action: Admin cannot replay, download, thumbnail or access media; viewed requires parent display/playback receipt.

screen_records.name: Failure reason & evidence
screen_records.action: No raw exception texts or third-party call data. Distinguish verified reason source from unknown context.

screen_records.name: No results or no access
screen_records.action: UI distinguishes zero result/403/401/422/429, no identity leaks in error or suggestions.

screen_records.name: Pagination and retry
screen_records.action: Keyset cursor with previous/next history, bounded page size max 100, cancellation and retry; scope checked every page.

screen_records.name: Administrator access audit
screen_records.action: Search, suggestions, detail reads and export attempts write audit; fail closed if audit not persisted.

screen_records.name: Privacy and retention gates
screen_records.action: Privacy-approved retention TTLs TBD; operator read-only unless separate signed change; backup/deletion protection.

screen_records.name: Session expired
screen_records.action: 401 and session expiry require step-up; no cached child rows displayed on expired screen.

screen_records.name: Access denied
screen_records.action: 403 must not reveal existence of target parent/child. Audit failed attempt. No admin superuser default bypass.

screen_records.name: Controlled export request
screen_records.action: Download/export disabled by default, requires case-bound dual control, audit and DLP review.

screen_records.name: Role and case assignment
screen_records.action: Manage role grants via separate governed workflow; root does not automatically receive child metadata rights.

screen_records.name: Audit service unavailable
screen_records.action: Fail closed for detailed access if independent admin-access audit cannot durably append.

Durably ingest independent app-usage session/event batches for background aggregation
Fetch pending authorized commands for own device
Child-initiated SOS delivery request; may remain pending
Get latest qualifying device position (never fake live)
Read bounded time range of original observations
List trip summaries and provisional revisions
Read source-quality route segments including explicit gaps
List inferred dwell locations and named-place matches
List late-data and algorithm correction revisions
Observe last heartbeat, last fix and last processed timestamps
Create verified, limited, expiring guardian invitation/grant
Revoke grant and invalidate live streams
Configure cautious arrival windows and uncertainty-safe alerts
Dry-run rules without claiming policy applied
Check deletion stage, with current auth or verified one-time reference
Finish enrolled device key proof; challenge must be fresh and single-use
Authorized parent revokes device credentials and stops further ingest
Madalasa reads child-scoped last device-verified compatibility, permission and freshness state
List own authorized children for media activity dropdown
Parent media activity metadata, filters and cursor pagination
Read own authorized media lifecycle and evidence
Restricted admin media activity search across authorized parent/child scope
Audited parent name or ID autocomplete within active case
Audited child name/ID autocomplete filtered by approved parent
Restricted view of audits of privileged search and detailed reads
